task.title: e2e auth broken?: Neon Better Auth rejects the 127.0.0.1:3000 origin the suite hardcodes
task.description: Filed from the P6-002 measurement session (2026-08-11). Signing in at http://127.0.0.1:3000/login now fails with a visible 'Invalid origin' alert; isolated via curl to NEON_AUTH_BASE_URL/sign-in/email: Origin http://127.0.0.1:3000 → 403 INVALID_ORIGIN, Origin http://localhost:3000 → 200 with valid session. playwright.config.ts baseURL AND end2end/measure-resource-ids.mjs both hardcode 127.0.0.1:3000, so if this reproduces from main, the setup project and every authed spec are broken against the documented recipe. NOTE the timing puzzle: the suite ran green repeatedly through 2026-08-11 ~04:00 ET, so the Neon-side trusted-origins config likely changed very recently — check the Neon Auth dashboard first. Fix EITHER by adding 127.0.0.1:3000 to the trusted origins (Neon side, no repo change) or by repointing the e2e config to localhost:3000 (repo change, two files + any other hardcodes a grep finds). Specs: e2e-suite skill conventions, specs/dev-environment.md.
